message.content: {"note_claim": "VAR protocol allows review of yellow-card incidents in cases of mistaken identity.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "Mistaken identity (red or yellow card) If the referee penalises an offence but has clearly misidentified the player who committed that offence and then gives the wrong player from the offending (penalised) team a yellow or red card, only the identity of the offender can be reviewed", "reason": "The IFAB page directly supports the mistaken-identity yellow-card claim, but the note's second claim (a yellow card issued instead of a clear direct red being reviewable) is only indirectly supported, since the page covers missed direct red incidents without addressing a yellow given in place of a red."}

parsed.note_claim: VAR protocol allows review of yellow-card incidents in cases of mistaken identity.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: Mistaken identity (red or yellow card) If the referee penalises an offence but has clearly misidentified the player who committed that offence and then gives the wrong player from the offending (penalised) team a yellow or red card, only the identity of the offender can be reviewed
parsed.reason: The IFAB page directly supports the mistaken-identity yellow-card claim, but the note's second claim (a yellow card issued instead of a clear direct red being reviewable) is only indirectly supported, since the page covers missed direct red incidents without addressing a yellow given in place of a red.
